newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil panel vote on Cardoso re-election delayed.
newsitem.headline: Brazil panel vote on Cardoso re-election delayed.

text.p: A special panel of the Brazilian Congress Tuesday put off a vote on a bill that would allow President Fernando Henrique Cardoso to seek re-election because of delaying tactics by opposition deputies, officials said.
The voting session was due to start at 0900 local but was delayed until at least 1100 local/1300 GMT.

Committee officials said the postponement was caused by the the insufficient number of deputies showing up for the committee session to start work. Opposition deputies who were there declined to officially register their presence.
